country.evidence_quote: After the original Mudcats era, Marco launched Marco Goldsmith’s Blue Heat, a band that quickly became one of Australia’s premier blues acts. Blue Heat toured nationally, won Best Australian Blues Album (1995) and Australian Blues Band of the Year (1997), and even supported the legendary B.B. King.
